newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean parliament approves new prime minister.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean parliament approves new prime minister.

text.p: South Korea's National Assembly on Tuesday approved the appointment by President Kim Young-sam of Koh Kun as new prime minister, a parliamentary official said.
A total of 198 members voted in favour of the appointment and 51 were opposed, the official said. There were three abstentions and four spoiled ballots.
Koh, 59, was mayor of Seoul from 1988-90 and held a variety of cabinet positions under the administration of former president Chun Doo Hwan.
He replaces Lee Soo-sung, who has been in the job for 15 months.

Kim has begun a wholesale purge of top administration officials to try to restore his popularity battered by a loans scandal involving bankrupt Hanbo Steel Co. A cabinet reshuffle is widely expected on Wednesday.
